packet_rule: packet_count >= 50 (INCLUSIVE) over the COMPLETE B2-filtered biflow; no class-count filter
population_label: FastFlow-style population with our TSLib capture-split and capture-aggregation training protocol
population_note: The POPULATION follows FastFlow. The TRAINING PROTOCOL is ours and is NOT claimed to be identical to FastFlow.
pairing_note: This 1s population is NOT paired with the 3s/5s/8s populations. It is a different, larger eligible set with its own frozen split.
source_pkl_note: The 34,378-flow pickle was deliberately NOT used; this population was rebuilt from the raw CSV archive.
timestamp_representation: int64 nanoseconds, exact, no floating point
boundary_rule: slot = min(elapsed_ns // window_ns, T-1) in EXACT INTEGER NANOSECONDS; a packet exactly on a boundary enters the UPPER slot; a packet exactly at elapsed == D is included
duration_rule: complete flow duration STRICTLY greater than 1 s

population_gate.note: B2 packet filter applied BEFORE biflow construction; packet_count >= 50 inclusive over the COMPLETE filtered biflow

features.true_meaning: total payload of FORWARD packets in the slot (pkts_dir == 1, same source IP as the flow's first packet)
count of FORWARD packets in the slot (pkts_dir == 1)
mean payload of FORWARD packets in the slot (pkts_dir == 1)
total payload of REVERSE packets in the slot (pkts_dir == 0)
count of REVERSE packets in the slot (pkts_dir == 0)
mean payload of REVERSE packets in the slot (pkts_dir == 0)
total_payload_forward / total_payload_reverse (index 0 / index 3), and 0 when the denominator is 0. It is a PAYLOAD-SIZE ratio, not a packet-count ratio.
slot_index * window_seconds; identical for every flow, so it carries no per-sample information

feature_3feat_meaning: forward packet count, reverse packet count, payload-size ratio
direction_convention: Direction is FORWARD/REVERSE relative to the flow's FIRST packet. It is NOT client/server and NOT device/network. The legacy suffixes dir_-1 and dir_1 are inverted with respect to the pkts_dir value they hold; the values themselves are canonical and unchanged.
feature_naming_status: legacy names retained unchanged for comparability

window_exclusion_1s.reason: At a 1-second horizon these windows give sequence lengths T = 11, 7, 6 and 5. Autoformer's AutoCorrelation selects top_k = int(c*log(L)) lags and the index goes out of range for every one of them (RuntimeError: selected index k out of range). TimesNet additionally fails at T = 5 (250ms), where FFT period detection computes period = seq_len // top_list with a zero entry, producing period = 0 and an invalid reshape. Both are intrinsic architectural limits at short sequence lengths.
window_exclusion_1s.policy: Only windows on which ALL SIX models run are shipped. No architecture, hyperparameter, feature array, population or split was changed; no sequence was padded to satisfy a model; no unsupported cell is run.
window_exclusion_1s.verified_by: per-model forward-pass probe across all nine windows, both packages
window_exclusion_1s.grid: 6 models x 2 feature configs x 5 windows x 3 seeds = 180 unique runs
